articles.title: 'Ashita no Joe' Manga Artist Tetsuya Chiba Dies at 87
articles.summary: Tetsuya Chiba, best known as the artist for the Ashita no Joe (Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow) manga, died on October 27. He was 87. Born in Tokyo in January 1939, Chiba made his professional debut with Fukushuu no Semushi in 1956. Following the end of World War II, he returned to Japan with his family after spending childhood in Manchuria, northeastern China. Chiba drew manga for various magazines early in his career. articles.title: 'Houseki no Kuni' Creator Launches New Manga
articles.summary: The December 2026 issue of Monthly Afternoon magazine announced on Friday that manga creator Haruko Ichikawa will launch a new sci-fi manga, titled Cosmic Mimimi, in the magazine next issue, scheduled for a November 25 release. Haruko is best known for Houseki no Kuni (Land of the Lustrous), which ran in Monthly Afternoon magazine from October 2012 to April 2024. The 13th and final volume went on sale on November 2024. Kodansha USA licensed the manga in October 2016 and published the 13th volum.
